title: The Lacquer Lobsters of Lost Button Day
description: On Lost Button Day, two lacquer lobsters sort the harbor’s missing buttons. A seamstress recognizes the square pearl one before it reaches her palm.
alt: Two red lacquer lobsters sort buttons in wooden trays by the harbor. One offers a square mother-of-pearl button to a smiling seamstress.
pairing: An imagined harbor holiday for lost buttons × lacquer lobsters sorting them by hand
